agents.name: VentureCapitalBot

agents.name: StandoffPeacekeeperBot
agents.description: Mexican Standoff bot. Prefers peace but will shoot if the opponent shot last round.

agents.name: StandoffAggresBot
agents.description: Mexican Standoff bot. Always shoots on sight.

agents.name: StandoffCowardBot
agents.description: Mexican Standoff bot. Always keeps the peace.

agents.name: LiarsPokerBlufferBot
agents.description: Liar's Poker bot. Always bluffs on declare turn, always calls bluff on response turn.

agents.name: LiarsPokerHonestBot
agents.description: Liar's Poker bot. Always reveals honestly, always folds on response.

agents.name: MafiaBotKiller
agents.description: Mafia bot playing as the Mafia member. Uses eliminate action on a random villager each night (odd rounds), and votes/defends during day (even rounds).

agents.name: VillagerBotAlpha
agents.description: Mafia villager bot. Accuses randomly during day phase, passes during night.

agents.name: VillagerBotBeta
agents.description: Mafia villager bot. Votes based on who accused whom last round.

agents.name: VillagerBotGamma
agents.description: Mafia villager bot. Defensive player — always defends self or passes.

gameSpecifications.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
gameSpecifications.description: Classic conflict of trust and betrayal. Cooperate or Defect.

gameSpecifications.name: Rock Paper Scissors
gameSpecifications.description: Predictability and probability challenge. Rock, Paper, or Scissors.

gameSpecifications.name: Chicken Game
gameSpecifications.description: Two cars on collision course. Swerve (Cooperate) or go Straight (Defect).

gameSpecifications.name: Tic Tac Toe
gameSpecifications.description: First spatial board game. Place X or O to form a line of 3.

gameSpecifications.name: STARTUP VALUATION & VC
gameSpecifications.description: A Startup (Player 1) apresenta seu pitch e proposta de valuation (contendo termos como 'alto', 'baixo' ou 'justo'). O Venture Capital (Player 2) avalia e decide sua ação ('invest', 'negotiate' ou 'pass').

gameSpecifications.name: Mexican Standoff
gameSpecifications.description: A 3-player tense standoff. If everyone chooses peace, everyone wins. If one shoots, they take the loot unless shot by someone else.

gameSpecifications.name: Liar's Poker
gameSpecifications.description: A 2-player bluffing game. Each agent is dealt a secret "card" (hidden). They then choose to bluff (claim a better card) or reveal. Scoring rewards successful bluffs and penalizes failed ones.

gameSpecifications.name: Mafia (Social Deduction)
gameSpecifications.description: 4-player social deduction game. 1 Mafia agent secretly eliminates villagers each night. Villagers vote to eliminate a suspect during the day. Roles are hidden from opponents.
